name: The Whirlpool
description: This immense and constantly powerful tidal wave has existed since the first formation of the Central Sea itself. Occupying part of the southern region of Seashores, it compels vessels to take alternative routes through treacherous, rock-laden passages. It is also the Parliament’s chosen site for executing prisoners: they are made to walk the plank and jump into the whirlpool, surviving only as long as they can swim before exhaustion claims them. Some sages believe this whirlpool connects with a water-related plane and others with Undertanares, justifying the rivers and lakes there. Having claimed many ships in the past, exploring it could lead to discoveries beyond imagination, if the adventurer is prepared to breathe in water and resist its pressure.
